approach: Add one path fn pair in athena-data paths.rs (`records_worktree_dir(common_git_dir)` = repo_state_dir/records-worktree, and `records_root(common_git_dir, repo_dir)` = the worktree if it holds `records/`, else repo_dir). Add `RecordSet::load_from_dir(root)` (walks <root>/records, same check_record_file, same `records/...` relative paths), then `RecordSet::load_current(git, treeish)` and `Records::load_current(git, treeish)`: worktree if present, else the existing git-tree load. Split Records::load into `from_set`. Move live (non-test, non-gate-check) callers to the current forms; give `read_records` and walltime callers `records_root`. Add an xtask scan test, a CLI integration test, a site-output check, docs.

decisions.choice: Read the worktree as plain files (load_from_dir), not via a git rev-parse of the worktree HEAD
decisions.reason: Seam B already reads files; one fs walk serves RecordSet and Records, needs no git in a scratch checkout, and keeps the same RecordFile shape so Records::load logic is shared.

rejected.option: resolve_tip(git) and pass the branch tip as treeish
rejected.why: Needs the branch in the current repo's refs; the request says a worktree under the state dir, and a scratch checkout without records/ must read only the worktree.

rejected.option: Patch each caller to pick a path
rejected.why: Per-caller patches are the fault the root-cause default rejects; one definition plus load_current forms.

decisions.choice: Fallback lives in paths.rs (`records_root`) and in `load_current`; worktree counts as present only if <worktree>/records is a directory
decisions.reason: One place decides; absence yields exactly the old behaviour (criterion 2).

rejected.option: Fail when the worktree is missing
rejected.why: Before the cutover there is no worktree; every reader would break.

decisions.choice: Leave gate checks that take a candidate treeish (reconcile.rs, history.rs, jobs.rs, attribution.rs), records_import.rs, admission.rs path classes, gh.rs/test_support.rs, and invariant.rs unchanged
decisions.reason: They judge a given commit's tree or copy main's records onto the branch; routing them to the worktree would change what they judge. They are not live readers of current state.

rejected.why: Would make the importer read its own destination and gate checks ignore the commit under test.

decisions.choice: Scan test is a text scan in xtask/tests (named records_reader_scan) over non-test code (cut at `#[cfg(test)]`), matching join("records"), read_records( with a repo-dir argument, and Records::load( / RecordSet::load( with exactly two args, allow-listing paths.rs, introspect.rs/walltime.rs (root-relative readers), store.rs/records.rs (the definitions) and the gate/importer files kept on treeish
decisions.reason: Mechanism for the single-path rule; shapes exclude citation strings like "records/jobs" and BOOTSTRAP_OUTCOME.

rejected.why: Flags citations in steward.rs and work_decisions.rs, which the brief excludes.

files.purpose: View::records and workspace copy use load_current
pass records_root to read_records / walltime callers if any; else untouched
worktree vs in-tree and fallback tests
walltime dir argument resolved through records_root
the records_reader_scan test (not in the brief's deliverables list; needed for criterion 4)
record the reader move, fallback, site out of scope, D111

steps: Add records_worktree_dir and records_root to paths.rs with unit tests.
Add RecordSet::load_from_dir (sorted paths, `records/...` relative) and load_current in athena-gate records.rs.
Split Records::load into load + from_set; add Records::load_current in store.rs.

Move live callers in athena-core and athena-cli (grep each site; skip #[cfg(test)] and treeish-judging gate/importer code) to load_current; change read_records callers to records_root(git.common_dir(), root).
Write crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs (worktree wins, fallback equals old, status and forecast with no in-tree records/).
Write the records_reader_scan test in xtask with a planted-read case.
Run xtask site with and without records/ and compare; confirm site.rs untouched.
Update docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md citing D111.
Run fmt, clippy -D warnings and the full cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: A worktree with a partial or stale checkout silently hides in-tree records
risks.mitigation: Present means <worktree>/records is a directory; the fallback and its reason are documented, and tests cover both.

risks.risk: Tests in existing suites set no state dir and could see a real developer worktree
risks.mitigation: records_worktree_dir derives from repo_state_dir, which is keyed by the test repo's git dir, so a temp repo has its own empty path.

risks.risk: Line numbers drifted or call sites missed
risks.mitigation: Producer re-greps for `Records::load(`, `RecordSet::load(`, `read_records(`; the scan test fails on any left.

risks.risk: Behavior drift in load_from_dir path ordering vs ls-tree order
risks.mitigation: Sort by path like git's ls-tree; test compares Records from both paths on identical content.

demonstrations.method: Integration test builds a temp repo whose records/ holds record set A and sets ATHENA_STATE_DIR so the worktree dir holds set B; each reader (Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records via records_root, walltime reader, status, auditor, reading carry, scope_guard, run, manage, proposals, audience, review, hestia, steward view, code_health, work_decisions, backtest, drain view) is called and checked to return B.
demonstrations.observes: Every reader returns B's markers and none of A's.
demonstrations.fails_without: If a reader still loaded in-tree records/, its assertion on the worktree-only marker record would fail.

demonstrations.method: Same test file: with no worktree each reader equals its old result; a second test runs `athena status` and a forecast in a checkout with records/ removed from the working tree and only the worktree populated, comparing stdout with the run on records/.
demonstrations.fails_without: A load_current that errors or returns empty when the worktree is absent fails the equality with Records::load.

demonstrations.method: Review paths.rs for the single `records-worktree` definition; the scan test (criterion 4) enforces no other join.
demonstrations.observes: Only paths.rs names the worktree dir; the scan passes.

demonstrations.method: Test A scans the real tree and expects no findings; test B plants a temp source with join("records") and read_records(repo_dir) in non-test code and expects findings, plus a file with only "records/jobs" citation expecting none. Output shows `1 passed` (nonzero count).
demonstrations.observes: Real tree clean, planted flagged, citations not flagged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the scan's matchers, the planted read in the test's temp tree would not be reported.

demonstrations.method: Run site with records/ present and with it absent (a temp copy without records/), diff the generated output; `git diff --stat xtask/src/site.rs` empty via git status/diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: If site.rs were rooted at the worktree, output would differ when records/ is absent.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked; existing tests are not edited.
Read the diff of both files.
demonstrations.observes: Entries state the reader move, the fallback, the site generator out of scope, and cite D111.

open_questions: Deliverables list crates/athena-gate/src/audit.rs (absent), jobs.rs, decisions.rs, lib.rs, records_import.rs, admission.rs; I judged them not live readers (jobs.rs and records_import.rs take a given treeish or copy main's records; admission.rs only classifies a path). The producer must confirm decisions.rs and main.rs by search; unchanged deliverables should be accepted.
The scan test lives in xtask/tests/records_reader_scan.rs, a file not in the deliverables list; the brief names xtask/src/main.rs, which could host it instead as a #[cfg(test)] module.
Whether xtask already depends on athena-data (needed for records_root); if not, walltime uses an equivalent env-based lookup would duplicate the path, so adding the dependency is preferred.
The worktree is created elsewhere (cutover job); this plan assumes its layout is <worktree>/records/....
